# Code of Conduct

OpenDQI adopts the **Contributor Covenant**, version 2.1, as its
project code of conduct.

The canonical text is published at
<https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/>
and is incorporated here by reference. Adopting the canonical
text rather than a fork lets the document benefit from upstream
clarifications and translations without local drift.

## Enforcement contact

Reports of unacceptable behaviour, or questions about how the
Code of Conduct applies in a specific situation, can be sent
privately to:

**Paul Fournier** — `pfournier597@gmail.com`

All complaints will be reviewed and investigated promptly and
fairly. The project maintainer is obligated to respect the
privacy and security of the reporter of any incident.

## Scope

The Code of Conduct applies within all project spaces (this
repository, its issue tracker, its pull request comments, the
project mailing list if any, and any other forum where
contributors interact about OpenDQI) and also applies when an
individual is officially representing the project in public.

## Attribution

This document is adapted from the Contributor Covenant homepage.
For answers to common questions about this code of conduct, see
the FAQ at <https://www.contributor-covenant.org/faq>.
